headline: Pawan Kumar resigns as independent director of Innovision
hook: Board seat vacant at Innovision Limited
summary: Pawan Kumar has stepped down from his position as a non-executive independent director at Innovision Limited, effective October 5, 2026. The company formally notified the stock exchange of this board-level departure. Retail investors in Innovision should note routine board changes as part of corporate governance tracking.
why_it_matters: Routine board change with no direct impact on share price

headline: Innovision announces a change in its board of directors
hook: Leadership shift at a listed SME
summary: Innovision Limited has officially notified the stock exchange about a change in its board of directors. The company submitted the routine corporate filing detailing the leadership update. Such administrative changes are standard procedure for listed entities on the exchange. Retail investors rarely see any direct impact on stock performance from routine board shuffles in small-cap companies.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact expected for retail shareholders.

summary: Innovision Limited has officially informed the stock exchange about securing a new order or contract.
